name: OmarCraft
author: Entangled-Forge
description: Productivity tools from the Omarchy bar: the ArtCraft Craft apps (PhotoCraft, FilmCraft, WordCraft and ten more), Typesetter, Memospot and Planify. See what is installed, launch, install one tool or a group, update, remove. Prebuilt packages only (Omarchy's or the Arch repos, or AUR -bin), through Omarchy's own package commands. Unofficial.
